description: This Java class implements a content file manager for static content (like images, JS, CSS, PDFs) using Infinispan cache. It provides methods to add, retrieve, and remove static content files for different merchant stores, handling data storage and retrieval within a distributed cache system.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implements static content file management using Infinispan cache, supporting add, retrieve, list, and delete operations for content files associated with merchant stores.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, effectively shutting down cache operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton access method to get the instance of the file manager.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Stores a single static content file for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static content file by name and content type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Lists all static content files for a given merchant store and content type.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Fetches or creates a cache node in the Infinispan cache for a given path.

methods.name: getNodePath
methods.description: Constructs the cache path for a store and content type.
